usage.guide: Call GET https://weather.hugen.tokyo/weather/current with x402 payment (~$0.01 USDC on Base). All query params are optional: pass city (e.g. ?city=Tokyo) for a city lookup, or lat & lon for coordinates. The response is a flat JSON object with current conditions — read temperature_c, feels_like_c, humidity_pct, wind_speed_kmh, condition (human-readable string), weather_code, and observation_time directly off the body. Plain synchronous request; no auth header or polling needed.
